subtitle.zh: 在 Thekla 干了一年多，说说我的体会——工作条件、要解决的问题，以及为什么这活儿值得干。
subtitle.en: A year at Thekla: the working conditions, the problems to solve, and why the job is worth taking.

translator.note: 招聘贴，语气按原文保持热情、口语。`The Witness` 按术语表写书名号，`Thekla`、`NVIDIA`、`Jon` 保留英文；`global illumination` 作「全局光照」，`parameterization` 作「参数化」，`simplification` 作「简化」，`level of detail` 作「细节层次」（LOD 语境），`streaming` 作「流式加载」，`codebase` 作「代码库」，`pipeline` 作「管线」。源文里第一个链接的锚文本就是 `The Witness`（指向 the-witness.net 的招聘贴），译文写成 `[The Witness](http://the-witness.net/news/)` 与后文区分；招聘贴本身那个链接拆成了 `[go check it out](http://the-witness.net/news/?p=815)`。

blocks.en: If you are following [The Witness](http://the-witness.net/news/) blog you may have heard that we are looking for programmers, if not, [go check it out](http://the-witness.net/news/?p=815).
blocks.zh: 如果你在关注 [The Witness](http://the-witness.net/news/) 的博客，可能已经知道我们在找程序员；如果不知道，[去看看这篇](http://the-witness.net/news/?p=815)。

blocks.en: I’ve been working on The Witness for a bit more than a year. So, I thought it might be a good time to write a bit about my experience so far, in the hope of attracting some talent to join us.
blocks.zh: 我做《The Witness》已经一年出头了。所以我想，现在正好写点我这一路来的体会，希望能吸引一些人才加入我们。

blocks.en: I have to admit that I had many doubts about coming to work at Thekla. I had a comfortable and stable job at NVIDIA, where I was held in high regard. The prospect of joining a small indie studio certainly seemed a lot more uncertain. However, Jon’s confidence in the game he was designing, and in his ability to support a small team during its development was very reassuring.
blocks.zh: 我得承认，当初要来 Thekla 工作，我心里有很多疑虑。我在 NVIDIA 有一份舒适稳定的工作，也很受重视。加入一家小型独立工作室，前景显然不确定得多。不过，Jon 对他正在设计的这款游戏有信心，也相信自己能支撑一个小团队把它做出来，这让我很安心。

blocks.en: Work conditions at Thekla match or exceed those at my previous employments. Compensation is competitive and the work environment is extremely flexible. Jon has very high respect for our time and personal needs, I’m sure he would go an extra mile to make sure you are satisfied as well. There are also unusual perks that you would not get anywhere else in the industry.
blocks.zh: Thekla 的工作条件不比我之前任何一份工作差，甚至更好。薪酬有竞争力，工作环境极其灵活。Jon 非常尊重我们的时间和个人需求，我相信他也会多花力气让你满意。这里还有一些你在行业里别处拿不到的特殊待遇。

blocks.en: Not only the benefits are great, but I in addition to that, I get to work on the stuff that I really enjoy. That’s not just the global illumination implementation that [I’ve been writing about](http://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2010/09/hemicube-rendering-and-integration/), but also many other interesting problems in my areas of interest (mesh cleanup, parameterization, optimization, simplification, exporters, image filtering, compression, etc). I get to design our whole production pipeline; how the game, the editor and the modeling tools integrate with each other. I architect and implement most of the engine; its rendering pipeline, the level of detail and streaming systems, the platform abstractions, etc.
blocks.zh: 不光是待遇好，除此之外，我还能做自己真正喜欢的东西。不只是[我一直写的那种](http://www.ludicon.com/castano/blog/2010/09/hemicube-rendering-and-integration/)全局光照实现，还有我感兴趣的方向上很多其它有意思的问题（网格清理、参数化、优化、简化、导出器、图像滤波、压缩等等）。整个生产管线都由我来设计：游戏、编辑器和建模工具之间如何衔接。引擎的大部分也是我架构并实现的：渲染管线、细节层次与流式加载系统、平台抽象层等等。

blocks.en: I think that we currently have a good foundation. Our main focus has been on quick prototyping. As the codebase became more complex I’ve tried to get things better organized, while still retaining our quick iteration times. Our builds are blazing fast, and the loading times are still fairly quick. The code is also designed to make it easy to prototype new gameplay elements, and while the rendering code has become more rigid, it’s still pretty easy to experiment and add new visual effects.
blocks.zh: 我觉得我们现在的底子不错。我们一直把重心放在快速原型上。随着代码库变复杂，我尽量把东西组织得更好，同时又保住快速迭代的节奏。我们的构建快得飞起，加载时间也还是相当短。代码的设计也顾及了快速原型新的玩法元素；渲染代码虽然变硬了一些，但要做实验、加新的视觉特效依然很容易。

blocks.en: There’s still plenty of work left to be done, which is why we need an extra hand. The game needs lots of polishing and some optimizations. There are still a few gameplay elements that need to be prototyped, and as we ramp up into production we will probably face unforeseen problems that will need to be addressed. We also plan to port the game to other platforms, some of which might require significant reengineering.
blocks.zh: 还有一大堆活没干，这也是我们需要多一双手的原因。游戏需要大量打磨，还需要一些优化。还有几项玩法元素要做出原型；而随着我们进入正式制作阶段，多半还会碰上需要处理的意外问题。我们还计划把游戏移植到别的平台，其中有些可能需要大改架构。

blocks.en: However, for me, this job is not only attractive just because I get to work on cool and challenging problems. The Witness is a game unlike any other. It’s a unique creative opportunity. It’s an opportunity to use my skills to make a difference. To make something unique and valuable. To influence people in positive and meaningful ways.
blocks.zh: 不过对我来说，这份工作的吸引力不只在于能处理又酷又有挑战的问题。《The Witness》是一款与众不同的游戏。这是一次独特的创作机会。一个用我的技能去做出改变的机会。去做出独一无二、有价值的东西。去以正面而有意义的方式影响别人。

blocks.en: As you can tell, I’m very excited to be part of it. If you would too, or you just want to learn more, don’t hesitate to get in touch with us!
blocks.zh: 看得出来，能参与其中让我非常兴奋。如果你也想，或者只是想多了解一点，别犹豫，联系我们！
